posts.description: Your favourite coffee just got even better. Café Cotinga is proudly caffeinated by Subko—specialty coffee, expertly brewed, in the heart of Goa. Come sip, relax, and enjoy A Goa Love Story. ☕🌿

⚽ FIFA World Cup Screening at Café Cotinga

Experience every thrilling moment of the FIFA World Cup on the big screen at Café Cotinga! Gather your friends, enjoy great food, refreshing drinks, and soak up the electric match-day atmosphere in our beautiful balcão. 

Whether you’re cheering for your favourite team or just love the excitement of football, Café Cotinga is the perfect place to watch every match.

📍 Café Cotinga, Tamarind Hotel, Anjuna–Assagao, Goa
🍔 Delicious food & handcrafted drinks

most_relevant.description: One the most beautiful cafés I’ve recently been in Goa! The ambience is soo amazing, even in such a small place. We went for Saturday brunch and immediately got a table for a group of 11! Jack was performing live music and we just couldn’t leave the place cause of his music, he was tooo good! The food was also really tasty! We had a lot of things, English breakfast, mutton burger, pasta and some good coffee! The place feels like a hidden gem only few can find, so do visit the place next time! 🙌🏼

We visited this place in July. What an amazing cafe! We went late in the evening and the staff welcomed us enthusiastically. They switched the AC on, turned the music on too and we were ready to place our order. We tried Vietnamese coffee, Tiramisu and a chocolate pastry and everything tasted good. Tiramisu could've been a bit better though. Loved the vibe and interior of the place.
I would like to visit again.

Had an amazing brunch at Cafe Cotinga! The aesthetics and vibe of the place are absolutely lovely, especially with the unique indoor tree design.
​We ordered a spread of dishes, and everything hit the spot. The Eggs Florentine were perfectly poached, and the Butter Chicken Croissant was a brilliant, flaky twist. The Hummus platter with pita was super fresh, and the scrambled eggs were perfectly cooked. Both the Hot Latte and Cortado were excellent—great coffee execution with beautiful latte art. Highly recommend this spot if you're looking for a relaxed vibe, great food, and a fantastic cafe experience!

Nice restaurant with a lovely garden at the entrance. Service was a bit slow, but the food was good.

We tried the Thai Essence Bowl and Greek Bowl. The honey peanut sauce in the Greek Bowl was a little too sweet, but everything else was really good. Overall, a pleasant dining experience.

A delightful experience overall. The live band created a wonderful atmosphere and added greatly to the ambience. The butter chicken croissant was rich, creamy, and full of flavour. The mango smoothie bowl was fresh and delicious, while the chocolate cake was perfectly moist and indulgent.

The owner was exceptionally hospitable and attentive. Although there was a wait for a table, we were thoughtfully provided with chairs and cold water while waiting, and then seated comfortably in the air-conditioned section.

The seating was comfortable, the desserts were excellent, and the overall experience was relaxed and enjoyable. A great place to unwind with good food, good music, and warm hospitality.

Rating: 4.5/5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Visited Cafe Cotinga and overall found it to be a nice place with a pleasant atmosphere. We tried the carrot and ginger cake, but it wasn’t quite to our taste. The cake was a bit dry, had no frosting, and the ginger flavor felt quite strong. After sharing our feedback, the staff informed us that it was a vegan cake, which may explain the difference in texture and taste. Had we known that beforehand, we might have chosen a different pastry or cake. While this particular dessert wasn’t for us, the café itself is worth visiting and we’d be open to trying some of their other offerings next time.

Was a very pleasant and nice breakfast place. The food was good. It was raining so that added to the beauty of the place. Their choices of omlets are really good. Their Orange cinnamon drink was refreshing and different, really liked it. Would definitely visit this place if around Vagator for breakfast or even coffee.

Tucked away in North Goa, Cafe Cotinga strikes an easy balance between rustic charm and quiet sophistication the kind of space where exposed wood, soft natural light, and a slow, unhurried tempo make it easy to sink into the morning. The English Breakfast landed as a hearty, well-composed plate: eggs cooked with care, sausages and beans holding their own without tipping into greasy excess, and toast that arrived properly warm rather than the tepid afterthought so many cafes settle for. The chicken sandwich, its single egg adding richness without overwhelming the bite, was clean and satisfying simple food executed with attention rather than flair, which is exactly what a breakfast sandwich should be.

The chicken bowl and mutton kheema, however, are where the kitchen really showed its hand. The kheema in particular had that deep, slow-cooked quality well-spiced, tender, with none of the dryness that plagues lesser versions while the chicken buddha bowl offered a lighter, fresher counterpoint with good textural contrast. Service throughout was attentive without hovering, the kind of quietly competent hospitality that lets the food do the talking. All told, Cafe Cotinga earns its spot on the North Goa breakfast circuis; unpretentious, generous, and consistent enough that a return visit feels less like an option and more like an inevitability. A must visit place if you're in vagator.
